in_marathi.name: Gabbar
in_marathi.long_meaning: Gabbar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Marathi language, Gabbar means 'fearless'. This powerful name is associated with the god Hanuman, who embodies strength, courage, and devotion.
